Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Support position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to support your digital campaigns and contribute to your team's success.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Support position. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to support your team in executing effective digital campaigns and driving online visibility and engagement.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation. I write keyword-targeted blog posts that have improved organic traffic for client websites. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring they are optimized for both user experience and search engines. My daily use of analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs allows me to track performance and provide actionable insights.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits. This has given me a unique perspective on optimizing for both traditional and AI-driven search, a skill increasingly relevant in today's digital landscape.

I am comfortable with content management, social media coordination, and reporting, and I am keen to support campaign implementation, platform maintenance, and KPI tracking. I am also a quick learner, adaptable to new tools, and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve shared objectives.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I am enthusiastic about contributing to your digital marketing efforts and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
